name: Auld Lang Syne: Cat and Mouse
source:
The story follows Bidala, the only priestess of the Cat Shrine. On a day like any other, she meets a strange visitor who claims to be the owner of her shrine... the Rat Shrine. 

Who is telling the truth, the cat or the rat?

Somehow, they will have to figure it out...

[From [url=https://quiesphere.itch.io/cat-and-mouse]Itch.io[/url]]

A Granblue Fantasy fangame about two Zodiacs of many years in the past.
translation:
故事围绕猫神社唯一的巫女比达拉展开。在一个平凡的日子里，她遇见一位奇怪的访客，对方声称自己才是这座神社的主人…这里是鼠神社。

究竟谁说的才是真话，猫，还是鼠？

无论如何，他们必须弄清楚…

[摘自[url=https://quiesphere.itch.io/cat-and-mouse]Itch.io[/url]]

一部《碧蓝幻想》同人游戏，讲述很久以前两位十二神将的故事。
